-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.LemmasEnts` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem wp_slice_literal_ex [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] [preSem : go.PreSemantics] {s :
    Stuckness} {E : CoPset} {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] {st t : go.GoType}
    [IntoValTyped V t] [go.IsUnderlying st t.SliceType] (kvs : List keyed_element) (Φ : val → IProp
    GF) : WP ((CompositeLiteral (go.ArrayType (go.arrayLiteralSize kvs) t)) (LiteralValueV kvs)) @ s
    ; E {{ v, ∃ l, ⌜v = intoVal (array.mk (go.arrayLiteralSize kvs) l)⌝ ∗ ∀ sl_ptr, ownSlice
    (slice.mk sl_ptr (W64 (go.arrayLiteralSize kvs)) (W64 (go.arrayLiteralSize kvs))) l (DFrac.own
    1) ∗ ownSliceCap V (slice.mk sl_ptr (W64 (go.arrayLiteralSize kvs)) (W64 (go.arrayLiteralSize
    kvs))) (DFrac.own 1) -∗ Φ (intoVal (slice.mk sl_ptr (W64 (go.arrayLiteralSize kvs)) (W64
    (go.arrayLiteralSize kvs)))) }} ⊢ WP ((CompositeLiteral st) (LiteralValueV kvs)) @ s ; E {{ Φ }}

theorem ownSnapM_not_null [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (sv : SnapshotM) :
    ownSnapM p dq sv ⊢ ownSnapM p dq sv ∗ ⌜p ≠ null⌝

theorem entsRO_lookup [package_sem : Assumptions] (s : GoSlice) (xs : List EntryM) (i : Nat) (e :
    EntryM) (He : xs[i]? = some e) : entsRO s xs ⊢ ∃ ls l, ownSlice s ls DFrac.discard ∗ entRO l e ∗
    ⌜ls[i]? = some l ∧ ls.length = xs.length ∧ xs.length = sint.nat s.len ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z s.len⌝

theorem csPts_not_null [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) (al :
    Bool) : csPts p dq c al ⊢ csPts p dq c al ∗ ⌜p ≠ null⌝

theorem entsRO_cons_len [package_sem : Assumptions] (s : GoSlice) (d : EntryM) (xs : List EntryM) :
    entsRO s (d :: xs) ⊢ ⌜0 < sint.Z s.len ∧ ↑xs.length + 1 = sint.Z s.len⌝
